articulation.label: shelf
articulation.alt: shelf: /ʃ/ → /ɛ/ → /l/ → /f/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /ʃ/: Tongue blade just behind the ridge; air flows.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/f/: Upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
articulation.audioText: The lamp is on the shelf.
